subject: Supplier activation checklist + email payload guidelines for invoice fallback
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@atlashardware.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier activation checklist + email payload guidelines for invoice fallback

Hi Evan —

Thanks for the rapid responses during onboarding. To make the activation smooth I attached the updated vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf and two short examples (compact-invoice-schema.csv and sample-email-payload.txt). Summary / ask below so AP can pick a path: portal-first, email-fallback.

High-level activation checklist (recommended):
- Complete onboarding form in the Drive (link above) and return signed DocuSign.
- Give us the first PO series that will be used (e.g., PO prefix and sample numbers).
- Decide go-live: portal (preferred) or email fallback. If email fallback, confirm the subject-line token convention and whether multiple POs on one invoice will be allowed.

Email fallback: guidance and required fields (if you cannot onboard to the portal immediately):
- Subject convention: PO:<PO_NUMBER> | INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER> | VENDOR:<SHORT_NAME>
- Attach original invoice PDF. If multiple POs are covered by the same invoice, list them in the message body under a header 'POs:' one-per-line.
- Minimum required in body header (copy/paste at top of message):
  * Vendor legal name
  * Redwood vendor id (we will provide) or Tax ID
  * Invoice date
  * Invoice total (break out tax if present)
- We accept a compact CSV attachment (see compact-invoice-schema.csv) for structured ingestion. If not available, we will OCR the PDF and attempt to map fields; this may add manual review latency.

Please review the two examples and reply to confirm: a) You can adopt the Subject convention above, b) whether you will send multiple POs in a single PDF or separate invoices, c) an expected go-live date for portal vs email.

Thanks — once you confirm, we will stage a test invoice transaction and validate matching rules on our side.

--
Marissa Cole
Manager, Vendor Onboarding 
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: compact-invoice-schema.csv (CSV)]
[Attachment: sample-email-payload.txt (TXT)]

From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@atlashardware.com>

Cc: ap@atlashardware.com
Date: 2027-08-29T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier activation checklist + email payload guidelines for invoice fallback

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the packet. A few quick clarifying questions from AP so we send the right payload the first time: 
1) PO stamping: our ERP prints PO numbers on the PDF, but we sometimes send a single PDF that covers multiple POs (pick tickets consolidated). Is it acceptable to list the PO numbers in the body header instead of embedding multiple PDFs?
2) Remittance: do you need a remittance address field in the header? We typically include remittance in the PDF footer only.
3) Tax and line-item detail: if we provide a compact CSV (per your schema) with line items, should we still attach the PDF?

We plan to pilot the email fallback while our team tests portal SSO. Tentatively target go-live (email) for 2027-09-06 if we can agree on format.

Appreciate the guidance — Evan
Evan Liu
Senior Accounting Specialist
Atlas Hardware

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@atlashardware.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier activation checklist + email payload guidelines for invoice fallback

Hi Evan —

Great questions, answered inline below and with concrete examples attached.

1) PO stamping / multiple POs: Acceptable — please list PO numbers in the body under a top header called 'POs:' and prefix each line with PO:. Example: 
POs:
PO: 12345678
PO: 12345679

Our matching engine will attempt to match totals across the listed POs. If a single invoice covers multiple POs, include the per-PO allocation if possible (line or allocation rows in the compact CSV). If you cannot break out allocation, we will match by amount and may require manual intervention for larger totals.

2) Remittance: Please include a clear 'Remittance:' line in the header block with either the remittance address or the bank instructions. If only present in the PDF footer, it's okay, but including it in the header reduces manual review.

3) CSV + PDF: Yes — include both if you can. CSV is preferred for ingestion (our compact-invoice-schema.csv lists required columns). Attach the original PDF (keeps audit trail). When both are present we prioritize structured CSV data for fields and keep PDF as backup.

Subject-line example we recommend (single-line, no special characters beyond pipes):
PO:12345678 | INV:2027-0456 | VENDOR:ATLAS

Filename convention for PDFs (helps ops):
ATLAS_INV_20270456_PO12345678.pdf
(or ATLAS_INV_20270456_POs_12345678-12345679.pdf if multiple POs)

OCR fallback notes: if we must OCR the PDF, allow 48–72h for validation depending on complexity. For invoices > $10,000 we trigger manual review and may reach out for allocation details.

If the above works, confirm the sketched subject token and whether you can produce compact CSVs for pilot invoices. We will run 2 test transactions and confirm mapping.

Thanks — cc'ing Vanessa and Karthik so ops and billing can weigh in on SLA and review thresholds.

--
Marissa
[Attachment: compact-invoice-schema.csv (CSV)]
[Attachment: sample-email-payload.txt (TXT)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@atlashardware.com>, ap@atlashardware.com
Date: 2027-08-29T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier activation checklist + email payload guidelines for invoice fallback

Marissa / Vanessa / Evan —

Quick internal confirmation and one small tweak from ops:
- Confirmed: subject token and header block approach. Require the top-of-email header block pasted verbatim (it should be the first text in the message body). This improves deterministic parsing.
- PO multi-line rule: allow multiple POs. If an invoice applies to more than one PO, vendor should either (A) provide compact CSV with per-PO allocations, or (B) list POs in the header and include a short allocation note (e.g., 'Allocation: 60% PO12345678 / 40% PO12345679'). Lack of allocation will push invoice into manual review for amounts > $10k.
- File naming: prefer the ATLAS_INV_* pattern. Helps reconciliation.
- SLA: for email-fallback ingestion we commit to 3 business days for auto/validated processing for invoices < $10k with CSV present; 48–72h may be needed for OCR-only.

Evan — if that is acceptable, please reply with the first sample invoice on or before 2027-09-02 so we can run the two test transactions and greenlight 2027-09-06 pilot. Vanessa and I will update the vendor_onboarding_form to include the subject token guidance before DocuSign.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Finance Systems
Redwood Inference
